shortDescription: Garrett Jin (@GarrettBullish) lost $35.44 million while shorting ZEC, then tried to follow the rally by going long ZEC 7 hours ago before quickly closing the position and losing another $79,000. According to Odaily, the figures were monitored by Lookonchain.
